# guix_secrets (Resource)

A private Scheme secrets declaration. Attach it to guix_blueprint.secrets for image or SSH provisioning through the installed guix secrets extension. This descriptor performs no Scheme evaluation or remote I/O. Inline contents remain in sensitive Terraform state. Removing this descriptor does not delete installed files.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "guix_secrets" "server" {
  secrets = <<-SCM
    (use-modules (guix secrets) (guix base64))
    (secrets-configuration
      (files (list (secret-file
                     (destination "/etc/example/private-key")
                     (content (base64-decode "${base64encode(var.private_key)}"))
                     (mode #o600)))))
  SCM
}

variable "private_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Pass secrets = guix_secrets.server to guix_blueprint. Image consumers install
# these files in a private copy after building; hosts install them before any
# required Guix deployment. The files never enter the Guix store.
# For source files referenced by Scheme, add explicit change triggers:
# file_digests = { identity = filesha256("/absolute/path/to/identity") }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `secrets` (String, Sensitive) Scheme source evaluating to a (guix secrets) secrets-configuration record. Accepts raw source, file(), templatefile(), or an explicit load expression. Evaluated only by a consuming leaf during apply. Relative sources and load expressions use the Terraform working directory; use absolute paths when referencing module-local files.

### Optional

- `file_digests` (Map of String, Sensitive) Explicit file change triggers, normally { name = filesha256(path) }. Terraform recalculates these during planning. Use for source files read by Scheme; the provider does not discover or evaluate private sources during planning. Keys are descriptive names, values are digests. Excluded from public Guix build inputs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identity of the secret declaration.
